text:
alice: FYI canary for release/2026.03 just failed automatic promote. Deploybot skipped due to label mismatch on the image.

deploy-bot: [automated] Canary skipped: image label mismatch (expected: release=2026.03, found: release=2026.02). See logs: https://ci.internal/logs/4965432100 :warning:

ben: ugh, is this the matrix build that tags by matrix axis?

alice: likely. build matrix had a flaky step that reused an old artifact. quick log snippet:
```
aws ecr describe-images --repository-name redwood/renderer --image-ids imageDigest=sha256:abcd1234
Labels:
  release: 2026.02
  build-id: 2026.02-rc5
```

carla: if deploybot expected release=2026.03 then the canary image digest is wrong. Did the CI publish the new digest? ci-bot, any publish events?

ci-bot: build 2026.03 passed but publish step retried with cached layer at 12:14 UTC. push event: https://ci.internal/builds/2026.03/publish (status: partial).

mike: what's the impact? Are users hitting prod routes or just canary?

alice: only canary. No traffic ramped. Canary was blocked from promoting automatically.

ben: options: 1) retag the correct digest with release=2026.03 and re-run canary promote, 2) rebuild + republish (safer), 3) pin downstream services to previous digest until we confirm.

carla: rebuild will take ~18m. Retagging an existing digest is faster but we risk mismatched build metadata in release notes. We need consistent provenance for compliance.

sophia: we have a 2-hour change window starting 13:00 UTC. It's 12:40 now. Do we want to act inside window or wait?

alice: decision needed: if we wait for rebuild, we miss the early window for customer-facing rollout. If we retag, we must add a release-note caveat and a postmortem.

ben: can deploybot accept a manual pin by digest? I can file a quick PR to pin the canary to sha256:efgh5678 (the correct new digest) if someone confirms which digest is authoritative.

carla: verify digest first. alice, can you fetch the digest that passed integration tests?

alice: checked: integration image digest is sha256:efgh5678 and that one was not pushed to prod repo due to a retry that swapped layers. The registry shows both digests.

alice: suggested quick command:
```
aws ecr batch-get-image --repository-name redwood/renderer --image-ids imageDigest=sha256:efgh5678 --query 'images[0].imageManifest' --output text
```

mike: if we pin to efgh5678 manually and re-run canary promote, do we break any attestation/provenance gates? eng-releases has to sign off.

carla: attestation expects build-id metadata. If we retag digest with release=2026.03 but the manifest has build-id 2026.02-* then audit will flag it. Need to record that action.

sophia: proposal: 1) Hold canary promotion (do not force affinity). 2) Trigger an immediate rebuild + publish in the next 15m. 3) If rebuild completes before 13:00 UTC, proceed with normal canary promote. 4) If not, schedule manual pin + documented release-note + postmortem.

deploy-bot: [automated] Canary promotion held by release coordinator. Reason: image label mismatch.

ben: +1 to the plan. I'll queue rebuild now and monitor.

alice: queued rebuild job: https://ci.internal/builds/2026.03/rebuild-1 (started). ETA ~16m.

carla: I'll prepare a short release-note appendix to include the provenance discrepancy if we have to retag. Also opening JIRA: RLW-2142 (Provenance: release label mismatch on canary).

mike: who owns the manual pin procedure if rebuild fails?

ben: I can do the pin and re-run promote, but need comms approval from carla for the release-note wording.

alice: rebuild passed and published at 12:57 UTC. New digest sha256:ijkl9012. Registry shows labels correct: release=2026.03 build-id=2026.03-001

ci-bot: publish event logged: https://ci.internal/publish/2026.03/ijkl9012 (status: success).

deploy-bot: [automated] Canary promote retriggered by alice. Promote started.

sophia: great. Keep release window on notification. If promote succeeds, we'll proceed with gradual ramp at 13:00.

deploy-bot: [automated] Canary promote succeeded. Traffic ramp scheduled at 13:00 UTC. :tada:

alice: action items:
- AL: add short note in release notes about transient provenance mismatch and that final canary used rebuild digest sha256:ijkl9012
- CA: JIRA RLW-2142 created and assigned to eng-infra
- BB: follow up on build matrix caching to prevent layer reuse

sophia: will announce to #release-notes before 12:59 and post a brief blurb after ramp.

carla: closing thread for now. We'll keep RLW-2142 open until infra fix.

ben: thanks everyone. :thumbsup:
